summary.text: Hannah Trebas is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 19, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Democrat Jane Weber.
She won the June 2, 2026 Republican primary over Derren Auger with 64.7% of the vote (455 votes).

paragraphs.text: Hannah Trebas previously ran for the same seat in 2024, when Jane Weber defeated her in the general election, 54.7% (1,798 votes) to 45.3% (1,491 votes).
